status_label: DRAFT / OPEN / Ring 4 / NOT LICENSED / HELD
citation_policy: Primary standards, official specifications, original research articles, and authoritative consensus sources provide terminology and design comparisons only. No external citation is evidence that a CAS Harness control is implemented, that a hosted state is current, that a scientific hypothesis is true, or that a product, safety, license, canon, or disclosure gate is closed.

external_primary_sources.title: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: T. Bray; RFC Editor
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Baseline JSON syntax and interoperability terminology.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: The CAS Harness strict JSON profile is narrower and is not claimed to be validated by this RFC.

external_primary_sources.title: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS)
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: A. Rundgren, B. Jordan, S. Erdtman; RFC Editor
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Comparison source for invariant JSON representations used with hashing and signing.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: The internal CAS canonical serializer is not asserted to conform to JCS.

external_primary_sources.title: Secure Hash Standard (SHS), FIPS PUB 180-4
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Definition and integrity role of SHA-256 message digests.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: A SHA-256 identity alone is not a signature, trusted timestamp, producer identity, WORM receipt, or semantic validation.

external_primary_sources.title: Digital Signature Standard (DSS), FIPS PUB 186-5
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Distinguishes digital-signature authentication properties from bare hashing.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: No Gate 5 artifact is asserted to carry an independently verified FIPS 186-5 signature.

external_primary_sources.title: Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Time-Stamp Protocol (TSP)
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: C. Adams, P. Cain, D. Pinkas, R. Zuccherato; RFC Editor
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Reference architecture for a time-stamping authority and proof-of-existence assertions.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: CAS Harness currently uses caller-declared process-local timestamps and does not claim RFC 3161 implementation or trusted time.

external_primary_sources.title: Certificate Transparency Version 2.0
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: B. Laurie, E. Messeri, R. Stradling; RFC Editor
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Reference for Merkle-based append-only logging, inclusion, and consistency concepts.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: CAS Harness does not claim Certificate Transparency conformance, public transparency, or an independently trusted log.

external_primary_sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: W3C Provenance Working Group
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Vocabulary for entities, activities, agents, derivation, plans, and provenance bundles.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: No current Evidence Packet is asserted to be a complete or conformant PROV-O export.

external_primary_sources.title: SLSA Specification v1.2: Provenance and Build Track
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts project
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Definition of software provenance and distinction among provenance existence, signed hosted provenance, and hardened builds.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: A locally observed SLSA predicate identifier without retained raw bytes or an independent trust root is not a SLSA assurance claim.

external_primary_sources.title: in-toto Attestation Framework Specification v1.2
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: in-toto project
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Separation of attestation predicate, statement, envelope, and bundle layers.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: CAS Harness does not claim that current local receipts are authenticated in-toto attestations.

external_primary_sources.title: Open Container Initiative Image Format Specification v1.1.1
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: Open Container Initiative
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Container image descriptors, manifests, configurations, layers, and content-addressed identities.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: Recorded OCI digests do not establish a hermetic runner, source correctness, or independent build provenance.

external_primary_sources.title: SPDX Specification 3.0.1
external_primary_sources.authors_or_issuer: SPDX Workgroup, Linux Foundation
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Open standard for communicating software bill-of-materials information, provenance, and integrity metadata.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: A recorded SPDX digest whose raw payload is not retained is not repository-replayable SBOM evidence.

external_primary_sources.non_inference: The publication does not certify the CAS Harness storage implementation or hosted configuration.

unresolved_citation_obligations: Recheck versioned standards and provider documentation immediately before any external submission.
Complete a clause-level conformance map before claiming implementation of RFC 3161, RFC 9162, PROV-O, SLSA, in-toto, OCI, SPDX, FAIR, or any provider retention profile.
Obtain qualified rights and disclosure review before distributing internal Harness methods, exact paths, provider details, artifacts, or derived diagrams.
Have independent statistical, causal, security, software-supply-chain, provenance, and research-integrity reviewers verify every citation-to-sentence use.
Do not use an external methodological citation as substitute evidence for a CAS-specific construct, intervention, causal, safety, product, or scientific claim.
closure_statement: This ledger supports a held research draft only.
